notes: Form N-14 (combined Information Statement/Prospectus, dates left blank as 'March __, 2021') for an open-end fund reorganization: both funds are stated to be open-end management investment companies, so fund_type is open_end_fund and the kind is merger per the kind guide. No shareholder vote: 'The Reorganization does not require shareholder approval', so shareholder_approval is not among the conditions and meeting_date is null. Record date: the excerpt lists an Appendix E 'Record Date, Outstanding Shares and Interest of Certain Persons' but it falls after the cut, so record_date is null. Targets: this filing's transaction is the reorganization of MainStay Epoch U.S. All Cap Fund into MainStay WMC Enduring Capital Fund; the filing also describes a separate U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund Reorganization (MainStay MacKay U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund into the same Acquiring Fund, also on or about April 26, 2021), and states the Reorganization is not contingent on it, so targets and n_targets count only the Epoch fund (n_targets = 2 if both reorganizations into the Acquiring Fund are counted). security_class 'common' reads the registered share classes (Class A, Investor, B, C, I, R6) as the funds' ordinary shares of beneficial interest; the filing does not use the word common for them. Conditions mapped from 'Terms of the Reorganization Agreement': no injunction or proceeding (legal_injunction); necessary approvals, consents, registrations and exemptions (regulatory_approval); truth of representations and warranties and performance of covenants (other); effectiveness of the Information Statement/Prospectus and no stop order (registration_effective); pre-closing dividend of all undistributed net investment income and net capital gains (ric_or_tax_status, an interpretation); tax-free opinion of counsel (tax_opinion). No outside date: the agreement may be terminated or amended by mutual consent or by request of either Board. No tickers are printed in the excerpt. The excerpt ends inside Appendix A (Form of Agreement and Plan of Reorganization).
